main_measure.name: OLS slope of demeaned next-bar return on forecast
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2 and timing gain > 0; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2; otherwise inconclusive

supporting_check.name: book timing gain (mean daily return minus position x coin mean daily return)

decided_by: The slope is positive with t >= 2 and the timing gain is above 0.
reading: The 1000-bar minimum is counted on the regression bars (those with a next-bar return in the same window) with a non-zero forecast, and the coin's mean daily return is the mean of all close-to-close daily returns pooled over windows.
